# Enquiry with no answer

## Goal
Two short follow-ups, each with one new fact.

## Steps
| # | after (days) | purpose | adds | knowledge topics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | Check the answer arrived | one detail they asked about | pricing |
| 2 | three | Close the file politely | an easy way back | contact, hours |

## Last step
Say we close the file and how to reopen it.

## Do not
- Write "just checking in".

## Opt-out line
If you would rather I stop writing, just say so.
